NLSA appoints new chair of the Board

Published 5 October 2026

The Northbridge Legal Standards Authority has appointed a new chair of its Board. The appointment starts on 1 January 2027 and runs for four years.

The outgoing chair leaves after two terms. The Board thanks them for their service and for leading the organisation through its recent strategy review.

The new chair has worked in consumer regulation for more than twenty years and joins from the transport sector.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
